exact_statement: For every integer m>=1, f_m=2*1[x0=1]*1[at least one xi=1 for 1<=i<=m]-1 on the uniform (m+1)-cube, represented as the union of the m distinct clauses (x0 AND xi), with supports ordered (0,i), M_i=1, pi_i=1/4 and lambda_i=1/m, has exact finite posterior partition weights S_B({0})=1/4, S_B(T)=m^(-t)*(a/4)^t, and S_B({0} union T)=t!*a^(t-1)/(4*m^t)*(1+(1-t/m)*a), where t=|T|>=1 and a=2^(-6/5). Its complete conditioned all-partition residual is <=(43/10) I(f_m), and its exact conditioned all-partition run-cost expectation is <=(23/2) I(f_m). A normalized prior w_k=1/((k+1)(k+2)) on lambda_i^(k)=2^(-k)/m pays at most v additional bits, giving bounds (53/10) I and (25/2) I respectively. Every point-mass posterior choice in this representation has residual/I tending to infinity as m tends to infinity.
